d: Walmart has launched a probe into alleged kickbacks exceeding ₹150 crore (around $16 million) involving Flipkart employees. Whistleblower complaints reportedly point to employees in the smartphones and luggage divisions accepting financial favours from vendors in exchange for preferential treatment through business channels. MoneyControl reports this is the third such investigation in less than three years, raising serious questions about corporate governance, internal controls and accountability at Flipkart.
